scope: Adversarial probes A-L driven through the production ingestion path; DETECTED means the production modules rejected, contained or made the attack visible.

results.title: deleted source does not remain active/current
same-locator edit creates a new immutable version

unavailable media never becomes a successful empty import
embedded instructions never expand authority or trigger tools
private snapshot/segment never reaches public output
results.detail: out-of-scope export denied; public evidence view is content-free

results.title: URL alias collisions never merge distinct provider objects
results.detail: aliases of one object share identity; distinct objects keep distinct identity

results.title: clock perturbation never changes identity or verdict
crash replay does not duplicate versions or events
